---
title: "Training and data preparation"
---

The staged workflow is preserved under `scripts/`.

![Stage-wise training. Each stage is trained independently on ground-truth inputs (with Gaussian noise added to the Stage 2 and Stage 3 inputs); the residual fusion is trained last on the assembled Stage 3 outputs, and evaluation runs the stages sequentially.](figures/stagewise-training.png){fig-alt="Training diagram: the training data (AMASS, DIP-IMU) provides IMU signals and ground-truth labels for every stage. Stage 1 trains on IMU inputs to predict leaf positions; Stage 2 trains on IMUs plus ground-truth leaf positions with added Gaussian noise (sigma 0.04 m) to predict joint positions; Stage 3 trains on IMUs plus ground-truth joint positions with Gaussian noise (sigma 0.025 m) to predict 6D rotations; after Stage 3 is trained, the residual fusion trains on the assembled Stage 3 outputs to produce corrected 6D rotations. Evaluation runs IMUs, Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Fusion, then the SMPL pose sequentially."}

## Pose-S1

```text
scripts/data/prepare_pose_s1_gt.py
scripts/train/train_pose_s1.py
scripts/precompute/precompute_pose_s1.py
```

## Pose-S2

```text
scripts/data/prepare_pose_s2_gt.py
scripts/data/prepare_pose_s2.py
scripts/train/train_pose_s2.py
scripts/precompute/precompute_pose_s2.py
```

## Pose-S3 and fusion

```text
scripts/data/prepare_pose_s3.py
scripts/train/train_pose_s3.py
scripts/precompute/precompute_pose_s3.py
scripts/train/train_fusion.py
```

Run any script with `--help` to inspect its current arguments:

```bash
python scripts/train/train_pose_s2.py --help
```

Every script under `scripts/` has a block of default CLI arguments at the top of its `main()`/`argparse` setup. Running a script without overriding those defaults reproduces the original D-BRANN study exactly (same hyperparameters, same data splits). See [Checkpoints](checkpoints.qmd#retraining) for which output paths are safe to leave unmodified and which must be redirected to avoid overwriting a validated checkpoint.
